quote: Participants who did not complete all aspects of the study were automatically excluded from the analysis. ... Data was analysed from all other participants who completed the study in full. ... 321 participants were recruited. ... High Hierarchy (N = 168) ... Low Hierarchy (N = 153)
reason: Independent check confirms primary manuscript identity by exact title, all eight authors, and OSF project URL https://osf.io/zb5j2. Both the explicitly recruited/analysed full-completer sample and the sum of the mutually exclusive Study 6 between-participant hierarchy conditions in Tables 1 and 2 (168 + 153 = 321; Petition 1 cell counts 145 + 23 + 112 + 41 = 321) confirm N = 321 participants for the Hypothesis 2 mediation on belief that an audit is justified.
